headline: Five Eyes warn AI will transform cyberattacks within months
body: The darkest move of the period so far. The security agencies of the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand jointly warned that frontier AI will reshape cyberattacks and defence, saying 'the timeline is not years, it is months.' A top-credibility warning like this raises Catastrophic Risk sharply, which is the main driver of Self-Destruction, the ending where humanity wrecks itself before superintelligence arrives. It also lifts Conquerors and weighs on the peaceful utopias. Capability news added to the mood: SpaceX leased Colossus 2 compute to Reflection AI in a $6.3 billion deal, and OpenAI released a cybersecurity-tuned GPT-5.5-Cyber model to vetted defenders. Zookeeper edged past Egalitarian Utopia in the rankings. Horizon Balance fell from +1.45 to +0.85.
movers_note: Self-Destruction +1.1, Libertarian Utopia -0.5 and Conquerors +0.5. The Five Eyes warning alone added Self-Destruction +1.09 and took Libertarian Utopia -0.50.
